title: SeqFeed: Improving Agentic RTL Code Generation with Sequential Behavior Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2608.16934v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: RTL code generation is a critical stage in hardware design, and the emergence of agentic systems offers new opportunities to automate this process. To generate correct RTL code, agents must understand sequential behavior, including how signals evolve and propagate over multiple clock cycles. However, effectively conveying such temporal information to agents remains a significant challenge. RTL code does not expose cycle-level signal behavior for a specific execution, whereas full simulation waveforms are too voluminous and noisy for effective LLM analysis. translated_title: SeqFeed：利用时序行为反馈改进智能体RTL代码生成
translated_abstract: RTL代码生成是硬件设计中的关键阶段，智能体系统的出现为自动化这一过程提供了新机遇。为了生成正确的RTL代码，智能体必须理解时序行为，包括信号在多个时钟周期内如何演变和传播。然而，有效地向智能体传达这种时间信息仍然是一个重大挑战。RTL代码不暴露特定执行的周期级信号行为，而完整的仿真波形对于有效的LLM分析来说过于庞大和嘈杂。为了解决这些限制，我们研究了人类工程师如何推理时序行为，并确定了有效反馈的三个要求：它应该是事件可寻址的、依赖可追踪的，并且可迭代查询的。在这些要求的指导下，我们提出了\textit{SeqFeed}，它包含两种互补机制：(1) \textit{SeQuery}，一种类似SQL的波形查询语言。
tldr: 本文提出SeqFeed框架，通过事件可寻址、依赖可追踪和可迭代查询的时序行为反馈机制，解决了智能体RTL代码生成中信号时序信息难以有效传达的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SeqFeed, a framework that addresses the challenge of conveying temporal signal behavior to agents in RTL code generation through event-addressable, dependency-traceable, and iteratively-queryable sequential feedback mechanisms.
